description: Bash permissions for the lt-tools plugin. Covers the bundled Node.js helper scripts (website mirror and comparison).

permissions.description: Run the plugin's Node.js helper scripts in plugins/lt-tools/scripts/ (mirror-site.mjs, compare-site.mjs) — narrowly scoped to the plugin's own scripts

Run the same scripts with the placeholder quoted (node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/x.mjs"), the form the plugin instructs so a home path with spaces survives. Bash rules match the literal command text, so the unquoted pattern does not cover it
